note: Pinned vendor source for the ROCm backend. ROCm 10.1 is the only verified toolchain (userland, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1); 6.4 (early probe) and 7.7 (original target) are historical.

primary.comment: The committed vendor/mlx-rocm-upstream/ tree is the authoritative source (byte-verified vs the sha). GDN tail fusion + graph-decode diagnostics on the decode path; launcher pointer fix (host Data* -> gpu_ptr<T>) for the deterministic HSA memory fault. Gates G1/G2 pass (maxdiff 0.0). See docs/quickstart.md.

build.comment: RX 9070 XT is gfx1201 (RDNA4), NOT gfx110x. ROCm 10.1 userland (amdrocm-*-dev10.1, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1) provides hip/rocblas/rocprim/hiprand/hiprtc/hipblaslt/rocwmma; pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/rocm/core-10.1 (see docs/quickstart.md).
